newsitem.title: UK: Israeli spokesman says bomb could derail peace. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Israeli spokesman says bomb could derail peace. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]

text.p: Israeli government spokesman Moshe Fogel said on Friday an apparent suicide bomb attack in Tel Aviv (Corrects from Jerusalem) that killed up to four people could derail the Middle East peace process.
"It is clearly going to hurt the peace process, if not derail it totally," Fogel told the BBC.
"It was a terrible act ... such a bomb attack occurring at this point -- I have to tell you that is abnormal behaviour that people cannot accept," Fogel said.

"We cannot accept a situation where we are involved in a peace process and then we get to a point where we have a difference of opinion and terrorism is used as a tool, a specific tool, to try to influence Israeli government policy."
Fogel expressed scepticism that the perpetrators of the bomb attack were not linked to Palestinian negotiators involved in the peace process.

"(Palestinian president) Yasser Arafat has given the green light to these organisations to carry out terrorist attacks upon Israel. He has winked in their direction and he's taken some positive action to try to perpetrate these terrorist attacks by releasing over 100 hardened terrorists from the Hamas."
